commands.commandLine:
powershell.exe -Command "@'
import subprocess,pathlib,sys,difflib
r=pathlib.Path.cwd();ref=pathlib.Path((r/'REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip())
a=subprocess.run([str(ref),'--help'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode().splitlines(True)
b=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'eza_port.py','--help'],capture_output=True).stdout.decode().splitlines(True)
print('same',a==b,'ref lines',len(a),'py',len(b))
for line in list(difflib.unified_diff(b,a,fromfile='py',tofile='ref'))[:200]: print(line,end='')
'@|python -"
